_comment: Used by /implement_plan when you run the code-writing stage in an isolated git worktree (parallel phases, experiments, or keeping main clean). NOT needed for /research-codebase, /create-plan, or /iterate_plan — those are read-only or edit only the plan file. To enable: rename to worktrees.json and set a setup command that installs deps with a fast package manager (bun/pnpm/uv). Do not symlink node_modules into the worktree.
